'''Stone Cairn Lake''' is situated in northeastern [[Elwynn Forest]], and holds one large island that gives the lake a characteristic ring shape. The lake is named after [[Heroes' Vigil]], the [[Stone of Remembrance|stone cairn monument]] erected upon the island to commemorate the huge loss of life during the [[First War]] against the orcs.

While the lake has previously been a safe place to make pilgrimages to, it has now fallen into the hands of [[Defias Rogue Wizard]]s who have settled on the island. The water also holds a tribe of [[murloc]]s who have raised crude structures on the southern banks of the lake. This area has possibly the highest concentration of [[copper]] in Elwynn.

==Trivia==
*A cairn is an artificial pile of stones, often in a conical form.
